    The endpoint inequalities (Lemma 4.3, upper-bound form) #

    For a string w of positive length over special biserial monomial data and a vertex v:

    Σ_{b → v} Z_b + noin_v + socend_v ≤ noout_v + n_v + extout_v (socle_ineq)

    where Z_b counts positions over src b without incoming edges labelled by a forbidden predecessor of b, noin_v/noout_v count positions over v without incoming/outgoing edges, n_v counts positions over v, socend_v counts socle endpoints over v, and extout_v counts pairs (endpoint, outgoing extending arrow ending at v). Combined with the bound for Ext¹(M, S_v) this gives s_v - η_v ≥ socend_v - extout_v, the inequality form of (4.1). The mirror statement top_ineq gives (4.2) in the same form.
